top_news.title: Toronto Blue Jays Takes 4-3 Win
top_news.summary: Toronto Blue Jays beat New York Yankees 4-3. Nathan Lukes: 2 H, 1 HR, 2 RBI, 3 AB Dylan Cease: 6.2 IP, 8 K, 1 ER, 5 BB, 2 H Luis García Jr. homers (26) on a fly ball to right field. Ben Rice scores.

top_news.title: Milwaukee Brewers Takes 1-4 Win
top_news.summary: Milwaukee Brewers beat Atlanta Braves 1-4. Jake Bauers: 1 H, 1 HR, 2 RBI, 3 AB Logan Henderson: 6.0 IP, 4 K, 1 ER, 2 BB, 5 H Cooper Pratt out on a sacrifice fly to left fielder Mike Yastrzemski. Joey Ortiz scores. Luis Lara to 2nd.

top_news.title: Miami Marlins Takes 2-4 Win
top_news.summary: Miami Marlins beat Washington Nationals 2-4. Jakob Marsee: 2 H, 1 HR, 1 RBI, 4 AB Eury Pérez: 5.0 IP, 4 K, 1 ER, 3 BB, 3 H Dylan Crews doubles (12) on a line drive to center fielder Jakob Marsee, deflected by right fielder Esteury Ruiz. Daylen Lile scores.
